query:
SELECT 'senate' AS chamber, state_code, state_name, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate1_vote_pct, candidate2_name, candidate2_party, candidate2_vote_pct, status, primary_winner, pct_reporting, called_winner
FROM senate_races
WHERE state_code IN ('GA','KY','OR','PA','WV','NE')
ORDER BY state_code;
